elf-b4-002.name: Rundgång
elf-b4-002.evidence: SHIP-BLOCKING. 'Rundgang' is a real Swedish second-hand/resale business in exactly this domain: Rundgang in Karlstad (rundgangkarlstad.se) is a cooperative circular retail gallery for second-hand clothing, re-make, rental and repair, where private individuals resell clothes on commission - it moved to Tingvallagatan 7 in March 2025. A second real bearer, Rundgang in Gothenburg, is a long-running second-hand record shop. The passage's 'Rundgang' is a resale platform that published a 2021 audit of the second-hand clothing boom, i.e. the same trade as the real Karlstad business, so the invented 2021 audit figures attach to a real named resale operator.

elf-b4-003.evidence: BORDERLINE. Kessler is a common surname and the real Kessler entity is a rehabilitation foundation rather than a shift-work chronobiology unit, so this is a partial-name overlap rather than a bearer collision - worth noting, not blocking.

elf-b5-002.name: Verran coast
elf-b5-002.evidence: SHIP-BLOCKING. Verran is a real Norwegian municipality (1901-2020, Trondelag, on the west side of the Trondheimsfjord, administrative centre Malm; split in 2020 between Steinkjer and Indre Fosen). It is a real coastal Nordic place, and Norwegian coastal pilotage is a real documented institution (pilotage in the 1274 law of Magnus Lagabote, first pilot act 1720, today Kystverket / Norsk Losforbund). The passage builds three centuries of invented pilot history onto the real place name under a Norwegian byline, so the fabricated tallies read as regional history of a real municipality.
